definitionZh: 面具复制的CSS属性设定了面具图像如何重复. 面具图像可以沿着水平轴,垂直轴,双轴重复,也可以完全不重复.
sourceDefinition: The mask-repeat CSS property sets how mask images are repeated. A mask image can be repeated along the horizontal axis, the vertical axis, both axes, or not repeated at all.
